local_benchmark_tier.description: Rapid local forensic validation split across 82 audio utterances

reconciliation_summary.finding: The 20.73 hours of Tamil speech belong to the full IndicVoices-R Tamil corpus comprising 407 unique speakers (382 train + 25 validation). The 7-training / 3-validation split represents the local 82-utterance forensic benchmark pool. The claim that the 7 training speakers held 20 hours is an audit nomenclature discrepancy now formally corrected and delineated into Tier 1 (407 speakers, 20.73h) and Tier 2 (10 speakers, 82 utterances).
reconciliation_summary.disjointness_guarantee: Zero cross-split speaker overlap across both Tier 1 and Tier 2.
